people.name: Baasha
people.line: Third king of Israel who ruled for 24 years.

people.name: Elah
people.line: Son of Baasha, king of Israel

people.name: Tirzah
people.line: Canaanite city that became the capital of Israel

translations.web: Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: And Baasha rested with his fathers and was buried in Tirzah, and his son Elah reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: So Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah: and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Baasha slept with his fathers, and was buried in Tirzah; and Elah his son reigned in his stead.
